entries.9a089a0f9a9d4358: A division in which the company manufactures and sells ICs, optical sensors, wafer-level packages, LEDs and more. The consolidated subsidiaries Hi-Components Aomori Co., Ltd. and Ome Electronics Co., Ltd. manufacture semiconductor products under consignment from the company, and Hayama Kogyo Co., Ltd. performs plating, part of the IC manufacturing process.
entries.a66149ff42a6a7eb: As its basic management policy, the company uses the keywords “passion,” “sincerity,” and “creativity” and aims to supply highly reliable products stably as its mission; its management strategy includes pooling the group’s knowledge, experience and technology, responding quickly to changes in the business environment, thoroughly applying manufacturing discipline through re-examining quality, cost and delivery in existing businesses, and starting mass production at the Taki Plant and building a stable supply system, among other measures. In business development, the company states that it will concentrate management resources on new business fields such as advanced packages and accelerate the development of new and high-value-added products.
